description: Image Description: The image shows two giraffes standing in an outdoor enclosure, likely within a zoo or wildlife park. Both giraffes have the characteristic long necks and legs, with distinctive coat patterns of irregular brown patches outlined by lighter, creamy lines. The giraffe on the right is slightly closer to the camera and is reaching its head toward a raised feeding station made of wooden posts and a metal basket containing hay or similar food. This giraffe appears to be eating or about to eat.
